description: Fixed Quick Start dialogue, including every choice branch.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The rhythmic clatter of wheels on rails fills the compartment.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Outside, Equestrian countryside blurs past — endless fields giving way to distant mountains.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Soon, very soon, Ponyville.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I lean back against the worn velvet seat, watching my reflection in the window.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's strange, this journey. This... new beginning.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The glass shows me...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Five fingers drum against the armrest — a nervous habit I've had since...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Since the Princesses found me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Months in Canterlot, sheltered in the castle's highest towers.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The very first human in Equestria. What a lucky...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: ...guy I am. Though "lucky" might be stretching it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: ...gal I am. Though "lucky" might be debatable.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luna visiting my dreams. Celestia's patient lessons about this world.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But even they agreed — I couldn't hide forever.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: My reflection shifts as I adjust my position, hooves finding purchase on the seat.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The royal summons still feels unreal. Princess Celestia and Princess Luna themselves...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Out of all the researchers in Equestria, they chose me. A recent graduate, a nobody.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Not bad for a young...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: ...stallion like me. Though I still don't understand why.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: ...mare like me. Though their reasoning remains a mystery.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: "Study Ponyville," they said. "Document what makes it special."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: As if the Princesses don't already know. There's something they're not telling me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The conductor's voice echoes from the next car: "Next stop, Ponyville Station!"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: My stomach tightens. No turning back now.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Celestia's words echo in my mind:

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: "Twilight Sparkle is my most trusted student. She'll help you find your place."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A whole town of ponies. And me — the only human in Equestria.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I glance at my saddlebags — packed with research materials and the royal seal.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Princess Celestia's parting words echo in my mind:

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: "Ponyville holds answers to questions we haven't learned to ask yet."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I stretch, feeling the familiar weight of my...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The spiral horn catches the light through the window.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A unicorn in Ponyville — where magic supposedly behaves differently.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I extend them slightly, careful not to hit other passengers.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A pegasus studying ground-level phenomena — unconventional, but that's the point.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: No horn, no wings — just four solid hooves and determination.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Earth ponies have their own kind of magic, after all.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The train begins to slow. Through the window, I catch my first glimpse:

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Thatched roofs. Cobblestone streets. A massive tree with windows carved into its trunk.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ponyville.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: My handler — no, my host — will be waiting at the station.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: "She has experience with the unusual," Celestia had said with that knowing smile.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Golden Oak Library stands out even among Ponyville's unique architecture.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: My home for the next year, by royal decree.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Princesses insisted I work alongside their most faithful student. Another piece of this puzzle.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The brakes engage with a long, metallic shriek.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Outside, ponies mill about the platform — a rainbow of colors and cutie marks.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Will they stare? Run? I grip the seat harder.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Celestia promised they'd been informed, but knowing and seeing...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: My cutie mark tingles — that strange sensation when destiny pulls you forward.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Whatever happens next, I'm exactly where I need to be.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The train shudders to a complete stop.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Steam hisses. Doors clatter open.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The conductor's final call: "Ponyville Station! All off for Ponyville!"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I take a deep breath, gather my belongings, and step toward the door.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Time to begin.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The platform's packed. Ponies everywhere, luggage carts rattling past.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I step down carefully. The platform's lower than I expected.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A few ponies stare. Most just glance and move on.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then I spot her.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Purple unicorn by the entrance, scroll floating in her magic.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She sees me and trots over.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "You must be the human visitor! I'm Twilight Sparkle."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Princess Celestia told me all about you. Welcome to Ponyville!"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She's studying me already.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Not sure if that's good or bad.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I stick out my hand, then awkwardly wave instead.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Of course! I've prepared your room at the library."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Not at all! I've been looking forward to this."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "It's not every day we get to learn about an entirely new species!"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I step down, adjusting my saddlebags. Try to look like I belong.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There she is.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Purple unicorn with a floating checklist.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She spots me and heads over.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "You must be the researcher from Canterlot! I'm Twilight Sparkle."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "I've been expecting you — the Princesses sent word ahead."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She's sizing me up. I know that look.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Please, just Twilight is fine. We'll be working together after all."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "I've cleared out the guest room and half the lab space for your research."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She tries not to look pleased.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "They're very kind. I hope we can live up to their expectations."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "I've prepared workspace for your research at the library."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Speaking of which, we should head there now. I'm sure you're tired from the journey."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "The library has plenty of room, and it's... well, it's quiet. Usually."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That "usually" sounds like it's carrying a lot of weight.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Shall we go? It's not far — Ponyville is a small town."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She turns and starts walking, her pace brisk but not hurried.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I fall in step beside her as we head for the exit.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A few more ponies glance our way as we pass.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Twilight either doesn't notice or doesn't care. Maybe both.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The crowd parts easily for us. Benefits of traveling with someone everypony knows.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Wonder how long before that stops being useful and starts being annoying.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The station falls away behind us, and Ponyville proper begins.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "I think that's enough questions for now. You must be eager to explore Ponyville!"

lines.speaker: spike
lines.text: "Yeah! There's so much to see. The market, Sugarcube Corner, Sweet Apple Acres..."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Here, let me give you a map. Ponyville might be small, but it's easy to get turned around at first."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Twilight's horn glows as she levitates a detailed map toward you.

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "Feel free to visit anywhere you like! Most ponies are very friendly."

lines.speaker: twilight
lines.text: "I'll be here at the library if you need anything."

lines.speaker: spike
lines.text: "And if you get hungry, just come back! I make a mean daisy sandwich."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: With the map in hand, you're ready to explore Ponyville.
